_meta.description: Tier 1 — WBSO/S&O (RVO speur- en ontwikkelingswerk) subsidie-administratie. Three new schemas (WbsoBeschikking, SoUurregistratie, WbsoMededeling) modelling the S&O-afdrachtvermindering beschikking, the legally required urenadministratie, and the annual realisatie-mededeling to RVO. Lifecycle/RBAC/relations are declared as schema metadata per ADR-031; the single cross-schema submit precondition (realisedSoHours <= grantedSoHours on a still-granted beschikking, REQ-WBSO-005) is delegated to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\WbsoMededelingGuard::canSubmit (ADR-031 exception path). Employees reuse the Nextcloud identity (employeeId), no app-local person schema (ADR-022). Seed data pre-loads one worked FY2026 sample beschikking + uren + mededeling.

WbsoBeschikking.title: WBSO Beschikking
WbsoBeschikking.description: An RVO S&O-afdrachtvermindering decision (WBSO-beschikking). Records the granted speur- en ontwikkelingswerk hours, the S&O-uurloon, the validity period and the RVO reference per administration. Source of truth for the realisatie ceiling enforced on the WbsoMededeling (REQ-WBSO-001).

beschikkingNumber.description: Internal beschikking number, unique per administration (REQ-WBSO-001).

rvoReference.description: The reference number issued by RVO on the S&O-beschikking.

projectNumber.description: FK to Project.projectNumber the S&O work is booked against (REQ-WBSO-006).

periodStart.description: First day the beschikking is valid (ISO 8601).

periodEnd.description: Last day the beschikking is valid (ISO 8601).

grantedSoHours.description: Granted speur- en ontwikkelingswerk hours; the realisatie ceiling (REQ-WBSO-005).

soHourlyRate.description: The S&O-uurloon in EUR applied to realised hours.

description.description: Free-text description of the granted S&O project scope.

state.description: Beschikking lifecycle state. granted: active; expired: period elapsed; withdrawn: revoked by RVO.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this beschikking (REQ-WBSO-004).

granted.label: Granted
granted.description: Active beschikking; S&O hours may be booked and a mededeling filed.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: Validity period has elapsed; retained for audit.

withdrawn.label: Withdrawn
withdrawn.description: Revoked by RVO; no further realisatie may be filed.

expire.label: Mark expired
expire.description: Mark a beschikking expired once its periodEnd has passed.

withdraw.label: Withdraw
withdraw.description: Record an RVO withdrawal of the beschikking.

project.description: The Project the S&O work is booked against (REQ-WBSO-006).

SoUurregistratie.title: S&O Uurregistratie
SoUurregistratie.description: A legally required speur- en ontwikkelingswerk hour entry. Each row logs hours worked by one employee on one WBSO-beschikking on one date, forming the urenadministratie RVO can inspect (REQ-WBSO-002, REQ-WBSO-003).

registrationNumber.description: Sequential registration number, unique per administration (REQ-WBSO-002).

beschikkingNumber.description: FK to WbsoBeschikking.beschikkingNumber the hours count toward (REQ-WBSO-005).

employeeId.description: Nextcloud user id of the employee who performed the S&O work. Reuses the NC identity; no app-local person schema (ADR-022).

workDate.description: Date the S&O hours were worked (ISO 8601). MUST fall within the beschikking period (REQ-WBSO-007).

hours.description: S&O hours worked on workDate; non-negative, capped at 24 per day (REQ-WBSO-003).

activityDescription.description: Description of the speur- en ontwikkelingswerk performed (required by RVO for the urenadministratie).

state.description: Entry lifecycle. draft: editable; confirmed: submitted by employee; locked: included in a filed mededeling, immutable (REQ-WBSO-008).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this entry (REQ-WBSO-004).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable hour entry, not yet confirmed.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Confirmed by the employee; counts toward the realisatie but may still be corrected.

locked.label: Locked
locked.description: Included in a submitted WbsoMededeling; immutable (REQ-WBSO-008).

lock.label: Lock
lock.description: Lock the entry when the covering WbsoMededeling is submitted (REQ-WBSO-008).

reopen.label: Reopen
reopen.description: Return a confirmed-but-not-yet-locked entry to draft for correction.

beschikking.description: The WBSO beschikking these hours count toward (REQ-WBSO-005).

WbsoMededeling.title: WBSO Mededeling
WbsoMededeling.description: The mandatory annual realisatie report (mededeling) of S&O hours to RVO per WBSO-beschikking. Aggregates the locked SoUurregistratie hours and carries the submission lifecycle draft -> submitted -> accepted (REQ-WBSO-009).

beschikkingNumber.description: FK to WbsoBeschikking.beschikkingNumber being reported on.

reportingYear.description: Calendar year the realisatie is reported for.

realisedSoHours.description: Total realised S&O hours reported. MUST NOT exceed the beschikking grantedSoHours (REQ-WBSO-005).

submittedAt.description: Timestamp the mededeling was submitted to RVO. Set on the submit transition.

rvoReceiptReference.description: Receipt reference returned by RVO on acceptance.

state.description: Mededeling lifecycle. draft: editable; submitted: filed with RVO; accepted: confirmed by RVO; rejected: returned for correction (REQ-WBSO-009).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this mededeling (REQ-WBSO-004).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable realisatie report, not yet filed.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Filed with RVO; covered hour entries are locked (REQ-WBSO-008).

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: Returned by RVO for correction; may be re-submitted after edit.

submit.label: Submit to RVO
submit.description: Submit the realisatie. Gated by WbsoMededelingGuard::canSubmit which enforces realisedSoHours <= grantedSoHours (REQ-WBSO-005).

accept.label: Mark accepted
accept.description: Record RVO acceptance of the mededeling.

beschikking.description: The WBSO beschikking this mededeling reports on.
